title: bookwright version --json output
description: Single JSON document emitted to stdout by `bookwright version --json`. Iteration 001-repo-bootstrap, schema v0.0.1.

package_version.description: Semantic version of the bookwright package, read from src/bookwright/__init__.py.__version__.

golem_schema_version.description: Version of the frozen GOLEM ontology schema bundled with the package. Reported as the literal string "unknown" when the bundled VERSION file at src/bookwright/schemas/golem/VERSION does not exist (case in iteration 001).
